note: Steps run in order. Each check runs from the repository root, exits 0 only when its step is done, and does not depend on the session. Step 1 starts from the commit that adds this file; step N starts from step N-1's commit. plan/results.json records the actual commits and check results.

steps.task: Replace the Span dataclass with a namedtuple
steps.brief: In plugin/makoto2.py replace the frozen dataclass Span (fields text, start, end, kind) with collections.namedtuple('Span', 'text start end kind'), and delete the dataclasses import. Importing dataclasses pulls in inspect on every hook call. Change nothing else.
steps.check: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'plugin'); import makoto2; sys.exit(int('dataclasses' in sys.modules or 'inspect' in sys.modules))" && python3 -m pytest -q tests
steps.parent: the plan commit (the commit that adds plan/steps.json)

steps.task: Document the cost measurement in the README
steps.brief: Add two sentences to the Development section of README.md: scripts/measure_cost.py reports per-hook wall time (cold and warm bytecode) and bytes added to the model's context on the events tests/ already contains, and MEASURE_REPEAT sets the repeat count. Change no other file.
steps.check: grep -q 'scripts/measure_cost.py' README.md && grep -q 'MEASURE_REPEAT' README.md && python3 -m pytest -q tests

steps.task: Record the cost after the steps
steps.brief: Run MEASURE_REPEAT=9 python3 scripts/measure_cost.py --json plan/measure_after.json and commit the file. Do not edit plan/measure_before.json.
